label: the shipyard builds the Kestrel and her rooms

eval: window.press = (x, y, dx = 0, dy = 0) => { const c = document.getElementById('yard-view'); const o = { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, pointerId: 7, button: 0, buttons: 1 }; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); for (let k = 1; k <= 8; k++) c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { ...o, clientX: x + (dx * k) / 8, clientY: y + (dy * k) / 8, movementX: dx / 8, movementY: dy / 8 })); c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { ...o, clientX: x + dx, clientY: y + dy, buttons: 0 })); return 1; }; 1

label: the declaration is clean and every declared part is built
expect: r => r.lint.length === 0 && r.parts === 20 && r.rooms === 8 && r.settings >= 75 && r.handles === 6

label: the panel has one control per declared setting
the checks run on the ship as drawn (the turret pod's wall is a finding, TS-S5-TURRETWALL; the Wren fits the bay door with her wings folded, s6)
expect: r => r.length === 5 && r.find((c) => c[0] === 'rooms')[1] === false && r.find((c) => c[0] === 'drives')[1] === true && r.find((c) => c[0] === 'wren')[1] === true
